reason: The free app already gives me 3 typed questions a day, and for a 15-minute kra pao or a pork omelet I'd never even use those up, so I'd keep the free version and never pay. I don't do monthly subscriptions on my allowance; 99 baht is two more plates' worth of ingredients.
objection: Will the dish actually come out right? If the free step-by-step can't get my kra pao right, paying for more chat questions won't fix it, and two dishes I mostly already know how to cook isn't worth paying for every month.
would_change_my_mind: If the membership unlocked lots more cheap everyday dishes I don't already know how to cook, not just more questions.
